theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_restricted_hasDensity
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t R : ℝ) (c θ : ℝ≥0∞) (W : Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R)) (y : Euclidean N), 0 < t → c ≠ ∞ → W.measure = c • (rescaledMeasure V x t).restrict (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → y ∈ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R → HasDensity n V.weight (x + t • y) θ → HasDensity n W.weight y (c * θ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
